1.name: Set up
1.forText: Telling UniGuide who you are and what you want.
1.parentNote: Help set a realistic budget, including living costs, before {name} falls for courses that don't fit it.

2.name: Explore
2.forText: Seeing what is possible for you.
2.doneWhen: At least one course is on your shortlist.
2.parentNote: Ask about the reasons behind each country, not just the rankings.

3.name: Shortlist
3.doneWhen: You are preparing at least one application.
3.parentNote: Look at the cost range of each shortlisted course together.

4.name: Prepare
4.forText: Getting each application ready before its deadline.
4.doneWhen: Every application you chose is submitted.
4.parentNote: Help gather documents like transcripts and certificates. The essays are {name}'s to write: encouragement helps more than edits.

5.name: Submit and wait
5.forText: Keeping track of what you've sent.
5.parentNote: This stage is mostly waiting. Patience is the most useful help.

6.name: Decide
6.forText: Choosing the right offer and securing your place.
6.parentNote: This is where parents matter most. Compare the true cost of each offer together.

7.name: Go
7.doneWhen: Your pre-departure checklist is done and you have arrived.
7.parentNote: Proof of funds usually needs your documents. Start early.
